One small action can sometimes teach you more than another hour spent predicting every possible outcome.

You might ask someone a question, test an idea, gather one missing detail, or try a reversible first step. Each action can give you something real to work with instead of another hypothetical scenario.

The Thinking Lens helps you explore questions like these when your thinking feels stuck: https://thethinkinglens.garrettsdevdesk.com

You may already know enough to take the next step. Sometimes you've just been looking at the problem from the same angle for too long.

A change in perspective can help you recognize what matters, what remains uncertain, and what deserves your attention next. You don't always need a perfect answer before making progress.

When you're stuck thinking through something, what helps you see it differently?
